issues.description: Field Bitmap24::data has inconsistent types across artifacts. In the template header (example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp) the member is declared as 'int *data;'. In the template implementation (example_program/src/Bitmap24.cpp) the code allocates and manipulates a byte buffer with 'data = new char[width*height*3];' and performs byte-wise indexing (data[...] with byte semantics). The solution header (example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp in the solution repository) declares the member as 'char *data;'. The mismatch between 'int *' and 'char *' will cause compilation/type errors when building the example program or tests and will confuse students about the intended buffer type.
issues.suggestedFix: In the template header example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp change the declaration of Bitmap24::data from 'int *data;' to 'char *data;'. Update the comment if necessary to indicate a byte buffer. This makes the header match the implementation (new char[...], byte-wise access) and align with the solution, removing the type mismatch and allowing the example program and tests to compile.
